head: 85c002b3a378a076fe118d75fcb665b5099dba46
verdict: No newly introduced silent wrong engineering answer confirmed within the pinned interval. Existing missing arc-length reactions are known wrong under #1949. Adjacent-boundary attribution does not establish earliest introduction.

release.explanation: Engine version metadata 0.4.0 to 0.5.0; release metadata, not an engineering quantity.

linear.explanation: Shared linear factorization/stability/refinement changes. This is source-based class attribution; only the refusal and selected reference transitions were bisected.

modal-basis.explanation: Entrywise mass-Gram modal guard changes its self-check values and thresholds; physical modal outputs in this corpus are unchanged.

span.explanation: New result-summary span shear/thermal recovery fields. Summaries are result data even when they are not primary displacements.

shell-combo.explanation: Combination shell stress records are now populated by the shared combination kernel.

pdelta.explanation: Span-varying axial force enters geometric stiffness, replacing end-force averaging.

moving.explanation: Forces outside a member at an axle endpoint are excluded; distributed axial patch boundaries are included.

buckling-wording.explanation: The #818 benchmark refuses at both endpoints; wording changes, not a new refusal.

ssi-unregistered.explanation: Previously empty support reactions become populated. No matching results-change write-up/registry entry was found. Parent/merge boundary replay confirms attribution.

arc-unregistered.explanation: Existing zero-start arc-length trajectories change numerically. PR #1885 precomputes the squared reference-load norm, regrouping products in the arc constraint, and evaluates the applied-load norm directly. No matching results-change entry was found; adjacent first-parent transition evidence is attached for one frozen input per benchmark family.

gallery-presentation.explanation: New view legends and site presentation data; not engine result changes.

gallery-slab-unregistered.explanation: Wall-supported example changes rotational restraints and replaces Kirchhoff reference with Mindlin reference. Input differs: this is not an isolated engine comparison. No matching result-change registration was found.

review.behavior: Design search becomes a generator; synchronous callers drain it.
review.shared_paths: Every design adapter, crossing-seat retries, deadline and cancellation handling.
untested_touched_paths: Real deadline/cancellation arriving between yields during a crossing-seat retry.

review.behavior: Central cable admission and final contact/member validity checks.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D linear, prepared, cable, contact, staged and advanced solves; native and WASM adapters.
untested_touched_paths: A real WASM run of each published frozen-state model through every affected advanced export.

review.behavior: Retain sub-rounding couplings for the numerical pin check; permit explicit releases.
review.shared_paths: Dense/sparse stability, reduced constraints and every subsequent pin check.
untested_touched_paths: The exact small-coupling counterexample embedded in physical 2D/3D models and passed through WASM; tests exercise the matrix kernel directly.

review.behavior: Enforce the stability verdict, refine conditionally admitted solves, remove artificial linear rotation springs and LU rescue.
review.shared_paths: Dense/sparse/PCG/prepared/constrained linear solves, shared Lanczos bounds, generated models, plastic hinge-state exemption.
untested_touched_paths: Nested or unwinding stability::assuming_stable scopes followed by an ordinary linear solve.
A real WASM equivalent-copy matrix covering the conditional-admission boundary and every prepared-load entry point.

review.behavior: Use sparse full harmonic solves above the dense ceiling instead of unbounded modal truncation.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D modal/direct selection, complex pivoting, fill budget and singular/non-finite refusals.
untested_touched_paths: Real WASM numerical solves on both sides of the dense ceiling and the sparse fill-budget boundary.

review.behavior: Plant wrong outputs in the metamorphic, differential and certificate oracles.
review.shared_paths: Empty intersections, dropped loads/fields, relative certificate bounds and nightly failure collection.
review.audit_followup: This audit adds the external per-field comparator plants; this is not a remaining gap in edited runtime code.

review.behavior: Add independent references for surviving static-solver mutants.
review.shared_paths: Dense/sparse/PCG, prepared loads, prescribed movement, recovery and warping assembly.
untested_touched_paths: The same planted arithmetic faults through actual WASM builds.

review.behavior: Bracket the fibre load-control limit and refine a failed increment.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D fibre solves, convergence failure and partial-load results.
untested_touched_paths: Actual WASM adaptive load-limit and termination-boundary reproductions.

review.behavior: Integrate axial force along a span in geometric stiffness and its independent certificate; mirror the law in the web second-order method.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D P-Delta, buckling geometric stiffness, certification and the web method.
untested_touched_paths: A real WASM end-to-end cross-product of varying axial patches, point loads, constraints and member reversal.

review.behavior: Use analysis-specific numerical uncertainty in invariance comparisons.
review.shared_paths: PCG, time history, harmonic, moving loads, buckling and retained failure accounting.

review.behavior: Tighten the snapshot applicability gate and benchmark-test consumer inspection.
review.shared_paths: Registry/model applicability, quantity applicability and disabled/changed benchmark consumers.

review.behavior: Budget exact plastic certification by actual work/storage and publish the certified 3D lower bound.
review.shared_paths: Exact arithmetic, LP construction, 2D containment, 3D raw solve/certificate and web certificate display.
untested_touched_paths: Real 3D WASM exact-certificate cases immediately below and above every work/storage cap; native usize arithmetic is not a substitute for wasm32.

review.behavior: Strengthen the modal mass-Gram guard for repeated eigenvalues.
review.shared_paths: Ordinary modal solves, certified modal and time-history basis consumers.
untested_touched_paths: Harmonic and Craig-Bampton consumers still bypass the strengthened modal guard; the PR itself leaves #759 open.

review.behavior: Use eigen/resolvent uncertainty for harmonic and spectral symmetry.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D symmetric/antisymmetric loads, retained clusters and finite/non-finite comparator verdicts.

review.behavior: Retain inconclusive/refused small-cluster verdicts and reject non-finite responses before allowances.
review.shared_paths: Mass tensors and shell stresses, both comparison sides.

review.behavior: Apply prescribed displacement patterns in 2D corotational and arc-length continuation.
review.shared_paths: Initial state, restarted state, load pattern, reactions and convergence reporting.
untested_touched_paths: A real WASM continuation from a nonzero initial state with simultaneous prescribed movement and member loading.

review.behavior: Check the original support contract before the OpenSees comparison.
review.shared_paths: Invalid/valid supports, related/unrelated refusals, linear/P-Delta and crash classification.

review.behavior: Scale ground-motion comparisons by the independently assembled inertial action.
review.shared_paths: Ground acceleration, ordinary applied loads, zero response and comparison reliability limits.

review.behavior: Bound support angles and share stable periodic normalization.
review.shared_paths: Assembly, constraints, kinematics and independent certificate assembly.
untested_touched_paths: Actual WASM boundary values through each advanced export, as distinct from shared native support-kernel tests.

review.behavior: Recover moving interior peaks and 3D axial point loads consistently, including patch/jump endpoints.
review.shared_paths: Dense/sparse assembly, combinations, diagrams/stations, geometric stiffness, independent reassembly and moving envelopes.
untested_touched_paths: A real WASM explicit axial point load at both supported endpoints with reversed 3D connectivity.

review.behavior: Share one support rule across dimensions and analyses.
review.shared_paths: Rigid/spring conflicts, free settlements, inclined normals, DOF numbering, certification and nonlinear entry points.
untested_touched_paths: The complete original-issue model-by-advanced-export matrix through actual WASM; native macro tests are broader than the WASM evidence.

review.behavior: Refuse non-finite buckling quantities and prepared/multi-case results.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D buckling, loads on trusses, case results and combination-only overflow.
untested_touched_paths: The exact finite-input overflow and negative-inertia models through real WASM exports.

review.behavior: Move net-area chain and web-line calculations into the engine.
review.shared_paths: AISC/CIRSOC tension connections, missing geometry and unsafe/unevaluated results.

review.behavior: Extend fixed-end-force and thermal references; production arithmetic is unchanged.
review.shared_paths: Frame load/release kernels and independent symbolic references.

review.behavior: Type the warping and combination result boundary.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D result serialization, bimoments, grouped stations, diagrams and web unit readers.

review.behavior: Centralize section constants and moment-gradient calculations in Rust.
review.shared_paths: Steel design inputs, slenderness/torsion constants and Cb station demand.

review.behavior: Use round-off-aware compression and member-local geometric stiffness in 3D buckling.
review.shared_paths: Buckling mode admission, reported member quantities and shared geometric-stiffness consumers.
untested_touched_paths: Actual WASM transformed-model tests at the compression-admission boundary.

review.behavior: Type result records and rebrand them once at the WASM boundary.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D serialization, force/length/rotation readers and malformed results.

review.behavior: Type distributed/thermal/support fields and keep exhaustive legacy conversion.
review.shared_paths: Both dimensions, pressure/edge loads, spring/angle aliases and member roll.

review.behavior: Add scale-invariant stiffness stability classification.
review.shared_paths: Dense/sparse matrix spectra, local free directions and anisotropy.
untested_touched_paths: Physical end-to-end public-entry tests for the exact #1931 sub-rounding coupling were absent here; #1933 later adds matrix-level tests.

review.behavior: Reject 3D connector-arm rotational mechanisms during shared validation.
review.shared_paths: Linear and every advanced solver using 3D validation; constraints and springs can hold the rotations.
untested_touched_paths: Dedicated contact/SSI/staged and actual WASM reproductions of the connector-arm fixture.

review.behavior: Build steel design requests in Rust and route the web through that boundary.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D beam stations, moment gradient, axes and verification requests.

review.behavior: Add tests killing surviving static-core mutants.
review.shared_paths: Stiffness, loads and recovery references.

review.behavior: Type coordinates and nodal/point loads; make mixed 3D deserialization unavailable.
review.shared_paths: Direct/inferred/nested native deserialization and the web wire mapper.

review.behavior: Reject 2D connector-arm rotational mechanisms during shared validation.
review.shared_paths: Linear and advanced validation, spring-held rotations, dense/sparse paths.
untested_touched_paths: The same connector mechanism with a free constraint slave; the PR explicitly leaves it out, and later generic constrained-stability coverage is not this exact fixture.

review.behavior: Refuse non-finite station demands, preserve unbounded relative bounds and mark RC torsion unevaluated.
review.shared_paths: Every demand converter, certified/native RC checks, independent assembly and JSON result admission.
untested_touched_paths: A real WASM finite-input overflow model followed through station extraction into every design converter.

review.behavior: Add independent element references killing surviving mutants.
review.shared_paths: Local axes, element stiffness and fixed-end loads.

review.behavior: Type 3D materials and sections at deserialization and preserve wire bytes.
review.shared_paths: Direct/native/most WASM wrapper parses and reproduction hashes; staged input typing is explicitly deferred.

review.behavior: Add torsion-release regressions after falsifying the proposed engine change.
review.shared_paths: Unloaded released rotations, unsupported torques and a continuous torsion negative control.

review.behavior: Release/version metadata only in the requested engine path.
review.shared_paths: Package metadata; no new numerical branch.

review.behavior: Protect result diagnostics from mutation in the web validity path.
review.shared_paths: Borrowed/frozen result objects and known-issue disposition.
untested_touched_paths: Aliasing of diagnostic arrays across independently stored advanced results and asynchronous publication.

review.behavior: Compute plate and combined von Mises without avoidable square overflow/underflow.
review.shared_paths: Plate recovery, shell combinations and signed stress components.
untested_touched_paths: A real WASM extreme-scale finite input with combined plate stresses.

review.behavior: Publish shell stresses for load combinations using one shared combination kernel.
review.shared_paths: Every shell family, thermal/settlement affine terms, envelopes and web combinations.
untested_touched_paths: Real WASM combinations across all shell families with both prescribed settlements and thermal loads.

review.behavior: Return SSI support reactions from the assembled equilibrium system.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D SSI and shared constrained assembly; nonlinear soil and rigid supports.
untested_touched_paths: The exact 2D/3D SSI reaction fixtures through actual WASM exports.

review.behavior: Add completeness and planted-missing-result assertions.
review.shared_paths: Shell stress families, reactions, case and combination result records.

review.behavior: Refuse ambiguous shell-family ids at the combination boundary.
review.shared_paths: Native/web combination kernels, spectral/settlement synthetic cases and generated identifiers.
untested_touched_paths: Real WASM combination/spectral/settlement calls for colliding shell-family ids.

review.behavior: Add superposition and reciprocity invariance coverage.
review.shared_paths: Native 2D/3D analyses, affine loads and independent response comparisons.

review.behavior: Add/extend advanced-analysis record-stamp tests.
review.shared_paths: Staged/moving/advanced result provenance; no numerical engine edit.

review.behavior: Judge span shear slope and released thermal curvature from recovered fields.
review.shared_paths: 2D/3D warnings, combinations, diagrams, section rotations and shear flexibility.
untested_touched_paths: A real WASM transformed and subdivided mixed thermal/shear fixture at the warning boundary.

limitations: Library-only unrefused plastic calls are explicitly named in the capture and are not treated as public engine answers.
Finite corpus, not proof that every engine call is sound. Native/WASM entry-point gaps remain in the merge review.
The 106 bundled web fixture blobs are identical at both pinned revisions. The public slab parameter boundary is the separate model/reference change.
As-shipped benchmark observations and same-input frozen reference comparisons are kept separate. Self-convergence targets are labelled and are not independent accuracy references.
References constrain published/readout quantities, not every zero, stress component or internal step. Exact floating changes are retained even below printed reference resolution.

Ordinary benchmarks use original assertion bounds; intentionally ignored cylinder, distorted shell and #818 cases were forced separately and fail at both endpoints. A passing tolerance gate alone does not establish movement toward the reference.
The site slab walls boundary changes the model as well as its reference; compare it separately from the frozen native corpus.
The large CAD gallery test exceeded its Vitest deadline at both endpoints after writing the complete capture; both raw engine captures are present. This is not a claim that every harness test passed.
An early native attempt reused Cargo targets across worktrees and linked stale artifacts. Those runs were discarded; only isolated endpoint builds and frozen replays supply the report.
A closure replay does not identify a fixing PR. Unattributed harness fixes are explicitly retained as unresolved rather than inferred from roadmap/cross-reference PRs.

The pinned endpoints lack three results registrations. Follow-up remediation in this PR adds the SSI, arc-length and public slab registry entries, result-change write-ups and exact frozen corpus. Two archived arc outputs omit reactions and are known wrong under #1949; expected-failure checks track them separately. No engine production fix, tolerance relaxation or advisory is included.

Historical bisection artifacts establish the recorded adjacent transitions, not the earliest change: monotonicity was unverified. Corrected scripts scan revisions in order. A full history rerun was excluded by the targeted-only, no-heavy-runs constraint.
